home.title: CarFix
home.description: Find nearby repair shops and compare prices, ratings, and distance in one simple search.
home.subtitle: Describe what your car needs, answer a few short questions, and get matching services with transparent pricing and up-to-date information.

howItWorks.title: Find the right car service in 3 simple steps
howItWorks.step1Description: Tell us what service your car needs and where you are located.
howItWorks.step2Description: We clarify your car details, parts preference, and search radius.
howItWorks.step3Description: Review nearby repair shops by price, rating, distance, and price update date.

whatYouCanCompare.title: What you can compare
whatYouCanCompare.description: Everything you need to choose the right repair shop more confidently.
whatYouCanCompare.item1Description: See the final price or starting price for the service you need.
whatYouCanCompare.item2Description: Check how far each repair shop is from your preferred location.
whatYouCanCompare.item3Description: Review Google ratings and the number of reviews at a glance.
whatYouCanCompare.item4Description: See when each price was last updated before making your choice.

popularCategories.title: Popular services
popularCategories.description: Start with the service you need most.

whyUseCarFix.title: Why use CarFix
whyUseCarFix.description: A simpler way to find the right repair shop without searching manually.
whyUseCarFix.item1Description: See prices, ratings, distance, and service details without opening dozens of pages.
whyUseCarFix.item2Description: Answer a few short questions and get matching repair shops faster.
whyUseCarFix.item3Description: Use Google ratings and review counts to compare options more confidently.
whyUseCarFix.item4Description: See when the listed price was last updated before choosing a repair shop.

forBusinesses.title: For repair shops
forBusinesses.description: Show your services, manage your pricing, and reach more local customers through CarFix.
forBusinesses.item1Description: Find your business, verify ownership, or create a new listing if it does not exist yet.
forBusinesses.item2Description: Add your service categories, update prices, and show transparent pricing to customers.
forBusinesses.item3Description: Appear where car owners compare repair shops by price, distance, and reviews.
forBusinesses.item4Description: See views, calls, directions, and website clicks in one place.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know before using CarFix.
faq.item1Question: Do I need to sign up to start searching?
faq.item1Answer: No. You can start as a guest and explore matching repair shops right away.
faq.item2Answer: We show a final price or a starting price, depending on the available information for each service.
faq.item3Answer: Not in the MVP. You compare options and then contact the repair shop directly.
faq.item4Answer: You can compare price, distance, Google rating, review count, and when the price was last updated.
faq.item5Question: Why should I create an account?
faq.item5Answer: An account lets you save repair shops, compare options, report price issues, and continue after the guest limit.
